checks.name: normal save → UI respawn → new launch UI Continue restores exact saved state

details.method: Saved via actual savePrefs; pause Restart button, separate same-origin page retaining localStorage, actual Continue button click. Captured in same click after restore before physics.

checks.name: natural replay completion restores paused live flight and every playback-mutated field

details.method: Real recorded frames and keyboard pitch input; actual UI replay button; capture-phase Replay UI listener and unchanged-call stop wrapper capture synchronous pre-start and post-stop state. No camera input follows pre-start capture. Natural completion is observed before the next live physics step. Geometry assertions independently rotate canonical axes by the rigid quaternion.

checks.name: complete hover forward-conversion scenario
checks.reason: Extended automated flight control is opt-in (--extended); basic save/replay tests do not establish a complete flight lifecycle.

checks.name: conventional runway takeoff
checks.reason: Run with --takeoff; no takeoff is inferred from an airborne spawn.

checks.name: vertical landing from hover scenario
checks.reason: Run with --hover-landing; a configured hover spawn does not establish a landing.

limitations: Cloud Chromium/SwiftShader functional tests; not Galaxy A51 evidence.
Normal UI start/scenario selection may position an aircraft at its configured spawn; tests label such starts. No lifecycle is inferred from teleporting aircraft state.
Replay stop is observed synchronously using a wrapper that calls the original function unchanged, before any later live physics step.
No Android installation, gyro, battery or thermal claim.
